messages.author: c16f1b13c9ab3235
messages.subject: BUG of multiple file Uploading??!!
parts:
Dear All,

I noticed there is a strange thing when you using "fileInput" widget, that is, there are only 2 "datapath" could be identified. Whenever you have more than 2 data files uploaded, the first data path will be end by "0" , the rest are the same and end by "4". So If you have more than 2 datasets, it will result in uploading identical files. There is an example, please note the red part:


  name   size   type   datapath
1   agilent.txt   101155.00   text/plain   /tmp/RtmpZaK3Nb/7641e0e3f3094c399fee91a1/0
2   hgu95.txt   87369.00   text/plain   /tmp/RtmpZaK3Nb/7641e0e3f3094c399fee91a1/4
3   hgu133.txt   94270.00   text/plain   /tmp/RtmpZaK3Nb/7641e0e3f3094c399fee91a1/4
4   hgu133p2.txt   147500.00   text/plain   /tmp/RtmpZaK3Nb/7641e0e3f3094c399fee91a1/4
5   meta.txt   820.00   text/plain   /tmp/RtmpZaK3Nb/7641e0e3f3094c399fee91a1/4

You can try with this page in where I just copied the uploading demo (https://gist.github.com/jcheng5/4050398):

http://glimmer.rstudio.com/chenm/MultipleUploading/

Is this a bug for this widget?
Thanks in advance
Chen

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: BUG of multiple file Uploading??!!
parts:
Yes, this is a bug that we fixed but have not released to CRAN yet. You can fix this locally and on your own Glimmer account by doing:

install.packages("devtools") # if you don't already have devtools installed
devtools::install_github("shiny", "rstudio")

Sorry for the inconvenience!
